name: Tenjou Kikyou
source:
The other candidate successor of the Tenjo family. She is the cousin of Rio and is one year older than Rio. She masters the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kenjutsu]art of the Japanese sword[/url].

She is the cousin of [url=https://vndb.org/c10154]Yuuto[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio[/url].

Kikyou is a person of principles for whom ethics, politeness and [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Etiquette]savoir vivre[/url] are essential to all girls. She is a nice girl who is recognized by the entire community as an honorable lady. However, she knows how to be competitive against her rival, [url=https://vndb.org/c2723]Rio[/url], for succession to the head of the Tenjou family despite her shyness.

[spoiler]She is very embarrassed when someone talk about about pervy subjects. She also thinks it's shameful for high school students to kiss each other and it's outrageous to have carnal relationships if they aren't engaged or married.[/spoiler]
